answer: Let standing decay under a short half-life unless refreshed by recent verified work, so influence is today's earning and never a permanent grant. An identity that falls silent slides down the glacier toward zero, stranded on bare tundra. A farmer cannot stockpile dormant clones and wake them for a vote — each must do real graded work every epoch just to keep its harbor of weight, so an idle swarm melts away while only the active agent holds altitude.
